approvedRules.title: Cancelled accounts cannot submit orders
approvedRules.description: Accounts with status 'C' (Cancelled) are blocked from all order submissions. This is a hard block — no exceptions.

evidence.docQuote: Accounts with status **C** (Cancelled) are **rejected** for all order types.

approvedRules.title: Suspended accounts are blocked from orders
approvedRules.description: Accounts with status 'S' (Suspended) are blocked from all order submissions per standard policy.

evidence.docQuote: Accounts with status **S** (Suspended) are **rejected** for all order types.
